detail.longDescription:
WorkBuddy is your AI work agent from Tencent: describe what you need, and it plans the steps, does the work, and hands back finished deliverables — not just chat.

HOW IT WORKS
• Easy input — say it or type it. Turn rough thoughts into an open brief.
• Clear steps — WorkBuddy plans the workflow and shows its progress as it goes.
• Expert know-how — pick from a team of AI experts tuned to your task.
• Delivered, not drafted — reports, tables, videos and more, ready to review.

WHAT YOU GET
• Deep research — a structured report with sources and recommendations, in minutes.
• Documents & tables — generate, edit and export work files from one conversation.
• Video & image creation — briefs in, finished visual assets out.
• Mobile access & phone control — start a task on the go, guide it from your phone, review the results anywhere.

WHY WORKBUDDY
• One workspace — your tasks, files and experts stay in context across the whole job.
• Enterprise-grade security — TLS in transit, AES-256 at rest, role-based access controls and audit trails.
• Built by Tencent — a global team you can trust with real work.

Work less, deliver more. Give your task to WorkBuddy and get your work back — handled.
Feature availability varies by country, region, and language. Subscriptions and skill installations are currently available only in mainland China.
 
Auto-Renewable Subscriptions
WorkBuddy offers the following subscription plans. Prices below are in Chinese yuan (CNY) for mainland China:
• WorkBuddy Standard Monthly: CNY 70 per month. Subscription period: 1 month.
• WorkBuddy Standard Annual: CNY 678 per year. Subscription period: 12 months.
• WorkBuddy Advanced Monthly: CNY 140 per month. Subscription period: 1 month.
• WorkBuddy Advanced Annual: CNY 1,348 per year. Subscription period: 12 months.
• WorkBuddy Ultimate Monthly: CNY 708 per month. Subscription period: 1 month.
• WorkBuddy Ultimate Annual: CNY 6,788 per year. Subscription period: 12 months.
 
Payment and Automatic Renewal
 
Payment will be charged to your Apple Account upon confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your Apple Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the current period ends. Each renewal extends your subscription by 1 month or 12 months, depending on your selected plan.
 
Managing and Canceling Subscriptions
 
To manage or cancel your subscription, open Settings on your iPhone or iPad, tap your name, then tap Subscriptions. Select your WorkBuddy subscription and tap Cancel Subscription. To avoid renewal, cancel at least 24 hours before the current subscription period ends.
